overview.description: The First Trust Indxx Quality Precious Metals Miners ETF (PMTL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in materials equity. The fund tracks an index of pure-play companies primarily engaged in the extraction, production, and refinement of precious metals, including gold, silver, platinum, palladium, rhodium, iridium, and osmium. Holdings are weighted using a quality-based approach alongside market capitalization. PMTL was launched on Jul 22, 2026 and is issued by First Trust.
